title: Observability
description: Can instrument a service so production questions are answered from logs, metrics and traces — and can choose which signal to trust when they disagree.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can emit structured logs with a correlation id, expose a small set of named metrics, and point at which field or series would answer a stated operational question — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can instrument one request path with logs, RED metrics and a cross-process trace, write queries that distinguish a healthy capture from an induced-unhealthy one, and redact secrets from the submitted sample.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently define SLIs and an SLO from existing telemetry, compute remaining error budget before and after a burn, and write an alert that pages on budget burn while staying silent on healthy traffic.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a failure where one signal type alone would mislead, cite logs, metrics and traces together, and produce a runbook another on-call can follow without opening application source.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's instrumentation or SLO, name a metric or alert that is toil or vanity, and teach when to trust a trace over a log line (or the reverse) on an unfamiliar service.
